title: Lelaki baru 6 bulan keluar penjara ditahan kerana bawa 8 PATI
summary: TUMPAT: Seorang lelaki yang baru enam bulan dibebaskan dari penjara, ditahan anggota Batalion 7 Pasukan Gerakan Am (PGA) hari ini atas kesalahan membawa lapan pendatang tanpa izin (PATI).

title_en: Man just released from prison after 6 months arrested for bringing 8 PATIs
summary_en: TUMPAT: A man who had just been released from prison for six months was arrested by members of the 7th Battalion General Mobile Force (PGA) today on charges of carrying eight illegal immigrants.

title: Six months after leaving prison, convicted migrant smuggler back at it
summary: TUMPAT: A 34-year-old convicted migrant smuggler, who was released from prison just six months ago, was arrested today for transporting eight undocumented foreigners.
